source: I want a soccer game with bots to play if there's no one to play with I want spawn to be a field with a world cup trophy in the middle of spawn then I want a shop so you can buy celebrations and dance then I want a goalkeeper to guard the goal. then I want rounds of 32,16 quarter final semi finals and then finals. If there is a tie it goes to penalty shootout up to 5 tries to win. Then I was a crowd around the stadium and hear cheering for the teams I want to have a flag pick between France Spain Portugal Argentina New Zealand America Canada Morocco Cape Verde Brazil England Uruguay Croatia Germany Norway. You can choose between any team and swap at any time not in the middle of gameplay though. then I want a shop so people can buy a flag to play 2,500 for Argentina 2,500 for other countries. You earn 250 in game coins for every win. Everytime you goal 10 coins. I want a cheer for the winner of the final. And a flag of Spain for them winning the 2026 world cup.

answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.

answers.ask: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch?
answers.answer: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should the stadium read as a real modern World Cup venue, or stylized and cartoonish? A: Use a real modern World Cup-style stadium, with a large crowd, national flags, and the Spain 2026 winner presentation.
- [author] scale — Q: Is the pitch regulation size with full stands, or a compact arcade-sized pitch? A: Use a compact arcade-sized pitch with full stands so rounds are quick and easy to play.
- [agent_inferred] spawn_relation — Q: Should the trophy and shop occupy the active pitch? A: Put them in an adjacent stadium entrance plaza on the same map so they do not obstruct soccer play.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a realistic modern world-championship soccer stadium with a compact arcade-sized pitch and full raked stands packed with a cheering crowd. Mark the pitch with touchlines, center circle, penalty areas, penalty spots, and two goals. Place team benches outside the boundary and enclose the field with a stadium wall. Add an adjacent entrance plaza on the same map with a central golden championship-trophy monument and an open shop kiosk for flags and celebrations. Display the 15 requested national flags—France, Spain, Portugal, Argentina, New Zealand, United States, Canada, Morocco, Cape Verde, Brazil, England, Uruguay, Croatia, Germany, and Norway—around the plaza and stands, with a special Spain 2026 winner presentation.

## Genre
The genre is Sports, canonical slug `sports`, because the map is a soccer field with formal scoring geometry, team starts, goals, and stadium spectators.

## Shape and preset
Use `space-bounded`, the Sports-specific Zone (Bounded Field or Court), for the rigid compact soccer-pitch perimeter. The matched preset is Full Stadium, expanded with the Field Sport options required for playable soccer.

## Config requirements
Use `spectator-bleachers` for full raked stands, `barrier-perimeter` for the stadium enclosure, `spectator-zone` for team benches, `npc-population` for the crowd, and `social-hub` for the adjacent trophy-and-shop plaza. Use the visible forms of `trigger-bounds`, `startpoint-play`, and `trigger-scoring` for pitch markings, center and penalty spots, and two goal mouths.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` TriggerZone around the pitch. Place `startpoint-play` StartPoints at the center restart positions and both penalty spots. Place exactly two `trigger-scoring` TriggerZones inside the goal mouths. Place exactly two free-text Spawners for goalkeeper bots, one centered in each goal area. Place `npc-population` Zones throughout the stands, outside all play and ball-containment boundaries.

## Layout components
The build contains one compact pitch, two goals, two goalkeeper origins, center and penalty markings, two team benches, full raked stands, one outer stadium wall, one adjacent spawn plaza, one golden trophy monument, one open shop kiosk, 15 national flag displays, and a special Spain winner presentation. Compose the pitch symmetrically with the plaza outside the active field.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: lay out the symmetric compact pitch, goal planes, penalty spots, benches, stands, and adjacent plaza first, then dress it as a modern championship stadium. The top-down plan is authoritative because fixed soccer geometry and fair team symmetry must survive.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is medium, driven by the confirmed compact arcade pitch while keeping full stands, goals, flags, and plaza features readable. The theme is a realistic modern world-championship stadium with a large crowd and national displays. Use `tiered` for the raked stands; all gameplay remains on one bounded field with no separate maps or overhanging play surfaces.
